rationale: The stock has already made an enormous intraday move (opened at $87.80, ran to $117.50 high) on earnings beat news, and is now sitting at 85.5% of its range with the 9-EMA at $114.03 above current price — suggesting the momentum has stalled and price is pulling back from the high. The bid-ask spread of 66 bps on a volatile name with only 68 minutes to close creates unfavorable risk/reward for either direction: a long faces resistance at the session high with the EMA overhead, while a short risks a squeeze back toward highs on still-elevated relative volume. With no clear structural setup and high intraday noise, skipping preserves today's realized gains.
